name: Axial/equatorial CD3 equilibrium in 1,1,3,3-tetramethylcyclohexane (EIE)

reference.citation: F. A. L. Anet, V. J. Basus, A. P. W. Hewett, M. Saunders, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1980, 102, 3945
reference.method: isotopic perturbation of the degenerate conformational equilibrium

reference.citation: M. Saunders, M. Wolfsberg, F. A. L. Anet, O. Kronja, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2007, 129, 10276-10281
G. Grazioli, A. Ly, D. Sabetnejad, A. Mattapalli, C. T. Nguyen, D. J. O'Leary, PyQuiverHS: A Web Tool for Computing Isotope Effects, ChemRxiv 2026 (preprint, CC-BY 4.0)
reference.method: source of the frequency calculations (SI data, Gaussian 16) and of the experimental value(s) quoted here, from Table 8 and section 3.5 (290.15 K); its PyQuiverHS results for the same files are in pyquiverhs/

notes: Compound 6 of Grazioli et al. (folder 'compound 5' of their SI data); the measured value is the one quoted in their Table 8. One frequency calculation serves as both reactant and product: the reactant carries CD3 on the axial methyl group (hydrogens 28-30 in this file), the product on the equatorial one (24-26). The EQE, (s/s')f_R / (s/s')f_P, is then [CD3 axial]/[CD3 equatorial]: CD3 slightly prefers the more crowded axial position. examples/eqe_cyclohexane computes the same equilibrium at B3LYP/6-31G(d).
